result.rationale: Verified: routes map put 'customize/embedding' => 'embedding#update', and Admin::EmbeddingController#update just re-renders the serializer output of a freshly fetched OpenStruct with no persistence — a no-op 'update'. The client's saveChanges action in admin-embedding.js.es6 calls this.get('embedding').update({}) but embedding.hbs contains no element wired to saveChanges (only addHost), so the whole PUT path is dead code. This is a substantive API-surface/design concern for reviewers, though not a runtime defect in the shipped flows.

adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `put "customize/embedding" => "embedding#update"` (config/routes.rb) but `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` simply re-renders the same serializer as `#show` without applying any changes. On the client, `admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6` defines an action `saveChanges()` that calls `this.get('embedding').update({})`, but `admin/templates/embedding.hbs` contains no UI element invoking `saveChanges` (it only renders the hosts table and an `addHost` button). This makes the PUT route and saveChanges action effectively unused/misleading based on what’s in the diff.
